description: Source file implementing Netlink socket operations for network interface and route management, including socket creation, message reading, route request sending, and route information parsing.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Class managing netlink socket communication for network route and interface information.

methods.name: Netlink::Netlink
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket descriptor and protection mutex.

methods.name: Netlink::connect
methods.description: Creates and binds a netlink socket with specified groups, sets non-blocking mode.

methods.name: Netlink::read
methods.description: Reads data from the netlink socket with optional timeout.

methods.name: Netlink::getDefaultInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves default network interfaces and gateways for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: _waitForReply
methods.description: Waits for socket reply within specified milliseconds.

methods.name: _getMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the socket with optional timeout.

methods.name: _sendRouteRequest
methods.description: Sends a netlink request to retrieve route information for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: _getRoutesInformation
methods.description: Parses netlink messages to extract default route info and gateways.

methods.name: _parseRoute
methods.description: Parses individual route message to extract interface index, destination, and gateway.
